text: The tournament economy numbers ARE in the web client, in the CREATE panel — not in the details panel the packet nominated. Prize unit = floor((entryFee × playerCount + 5) × 0.75 / 7), paid out 4u / 2u / 1u to 1st/2nd/3rd. Player count ladder 2/4/8/16 (2 gated on a premium flag), entry fee clamped 0…100, level range clamped 5…80, round duration ladder 0.5/1/2/24/48 h. Creating a tournament costs 5 of currency-stat 20112 (waived on the premium flag); joining costs `entryfee` of the same stat.
